name: vbp1-skills
description: Vadim Ponomarev's agent skills for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI.

metadata.description: Vadim Ponomarev's agent skills for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex CLI.

plugins.name: audio-restore
plugins.description: Restore muffled or low-quality recordings: stem separation, EQ correction, high-frequency recovery.

plugins.name: break-it
plugins.description: Adversarial test pass: write tests that try to falsify a change, keep only the ones that catch real defects.

plugins.name: claude-review
plugins.description: Cross-agent review workflow: Codex implements, Claude Code reviews, findings loop back until resolved.

plugins.name: cloakbrowser
plugins.description: Inspect web pages in a local stealth Chromium: screenshots, client-side JS errors, failed requests, long-task timings. Claude Code variant.

plugins.name: cloakbrowser-codex
plugins.description: Inspect web pages in a local stealth Chromium: screenshots and visual UI checks. Codex CLI variant.

plugins.name: codex-genimage
plugins.description: Generate images through the Codex CLI built-in image tool, billed via existing Codex auth instead of a separate API key.

plugins.name: create-pr
plugins.description: Branch, commit, push, open the pull request, then set labels and project fields in one pass. Claude Code variant.

plugins.name: create-pr-codex
plugins.description: Branch, commit, push, open the pull request, then set labels and project fields in one pass. Codex CLI variant.

plugins.name: decision-playground
plugins.description: Turn a long list of choices into a self-contained interactive HTML page and read the answers back as structured data.

plugins.name: feature-challenge-workflow
plugins.description: Challenge a feature request before any code: confirm the real problem, check existing capability, weigh alternatives, pass decision gates.

plugins.name: feature-plan-storyboard
plugins.description: Plan a feature, verify every claim against the current code, then build an interactive user-story storyboard page.

plugins.name: langfuse-debug
plugins.description: Investigate agent runs recorded in Langfuse: failed sessions, token usage, tool-call patterns.

plugins.name: phased-task-delivery
plugins.description: Run a complex task through explicit phases: plan documents, checklists, review gates, per-phase commits, final full-suite validation.

plugins.name: remote-ssh-workspace
plugins.description: Make a remote host behave like a local worktree: SSH multiplexing, sshfs mounts, detached long jobs with logs.

plugins.name: review-panel
plugins.description: Parallel read-only review tracks over a diff: mechanical triage, one agent per lens, adversarial verification, persisted rounds, re-review until clean.

plugins.name: rust-code-review
plugins.description: Review Rust for hazards that survive cargo build, cargo test and clippy: async, unsafe, lifetimes, lock and transaction flows.

plugins.name: simple-tech-writing
plugins.description: Rewrite technical text so a tired reader cannot misread it: ASD-STE100 structural rules plus a Russian rule set.

plugins.name: technical-premortem
plugins.description: Assess a planned change before it is written: blast radius, rollback plan, pre-flight checklist, go/no-go verdict.

plugins.name: user-clear-communication
plugins.description: Write user-facing replies, statuses and reports that stay readable: plain wording, explicit outcomes, no filler.

plugins.name: youtube-transcript
plugins.description: Pull the transcript of a YouTube video, with or without timestamps.
